status: synthetic fixed-count push prototype; loopback network; not full publication protocol
entrypoint: Trusted driver calls admit_delivery only after inherited ordered RELEASE qualification. No untrusted fetch/readiness/status RPC.

identities.route: immutable (tenant, recipient, gateway, session) plus both TLS certificate fingerprints and separately configured application signing keys/kids
identities.session: durable logical delivery session, not a TLS session or connection ID; reconnect retains the original route
identities.management: trusted in-process registration/revocation; no public management API, credential rotation or workload attestation
identities.transport: mTLS fixed CA and expected server hostname; exact server certificate pin checked BEFORE any application/result bytes; receiver matches verified client certificate fingerprint to configured gateway

outbox.registration: on_delivery_admitted hook creates QUEUED outbox row in same witnessed L3 transaction as ticket; rejection/crash commits neither or both
outbox.prepare: verify live route, original ticket expiry, earliest unacknowledged route sequence, result binding and gateway signing key; persist encrypted immutable COSE envelope, READY state and handoff admission before network send
outbox.encryption: StateVault AEAD kind delivery-envelope with identity (tenant, delivery_id); signed acknowledgements and request evidence encrypted with kind delivery-ack
outbox.authority: full route/outbox/receipt tables included in authoritative witness images and exact recovery
outbox.retry: same signed envelope and result, fresh 32-byte attempt challenge; no new mechanism run, budget charge, L3 admission or expiry extension
outbox.ack: verify pinned recipient signer/kid, signature domain, current attempt challenge/request digest, envelope hash, identity and historical acceptance time; persist ACKED and receipt in witnessed transaction
outbox.ack_after_expiry: Historical valid ACK may be persisted after original expiry; this does not authorize another result transmission

envelope.format: restricted deterministic CBOR inside tagged COSE_Sign1 Ed25519 alg -19
envelope.gateway_claim: Gateway attests original ticket/result binding; recipient trusts gateway, not an independently verified ledger execution proof

acknowledgement.meaning: Configured recipient claims durable inbox acceptance; not evidence of downstream business effects, human reading, or honest storage by a malicious recipient

recipient.storage: separate SQLite inbox, separately injected StateVault key, fixed route/profile check; envelope encrypted before SQL write
recipient.uniqueness: one record per delivery_id and sequence within the fixed deployment/route inbox; not once per operation across multiple lawful tickets
recipient.transaction: BEGIN IMMEDIATE; clock floor; exact-duplicate check or first-insert expiry and next-sequence check; commit before ACK signature/send
recipient.duplicates: only byte-identical envelope can reuse record; fresh challenge yields fresh signed ACK carrying original accepted_at; no second insertion
recipient.clock: trusted integer time; rollback rejected; floor persists on business rejection; accepted_at is sampled inside the receipt transaction, not a physical commit deadline
assumptions: durable nonrollback inbox and retained dedup records
recipient.excluded: No protection against recipient restoring a stale inbox, deleting dedup tombstones, lying in ACK, or repeating downstream business effects

ordering.implemented: FIFO within one fixed route; sender cannot attempt later unacknowledged sequence; recipient rejects unseen sequence gaps
ordering.expired_head: Fail closed; no automatic gap skip, reset or lifetime extension. Later tickets remain blocked
ordering.remaining: signed terminal/withheld events, authenticated gap reconciliation, cross-route protection-domain publication, safe GC and complete network observation refinement

revocation.authority: new L3 checks current root/chain; already admitted original ticket may finish until its original expiry
revocation.transport_route: revoked route blocks future preparation including old tickets; already prepared/in-flight bytes are not recalled
revocation.credential_expiry: TLS library enforces certificate validity; no CA lifecycle/OCSP/CRL system

failure_matrix.before_l3_commit: no ticket/outbox or authoritative committed pair requiring recovery
failure_matrix.before_outbox_commit: no usable send envelope is returned
failure_matrix.witness_accepts_outbox_local_fails: recover exact READY envelope before send
failure_matrix.after_outbox_commit_before_send: retry original envelope within ticket lifetime
failure_matrix.after_inbox_commit_ack_lost: exact retry returns same acceptance fact; one inbox record
failure_matrix.after_ack_received_before_sender_commit: outbox may remain READY; same-envelope retry safe under inbox assumptions
failure_matrix.witness_accepts_ack_local_fails: recover ACKED state; no new network send
failure_matrix.expired_unknown_outcome: no result retransmission; historical ACK can be stored if already held; receipt-only reconciliation still missing

network.bind: 127.0.0.1 ephemeral port only; server closed after tests
network.deadline: monotonic client deadline across connect/handshake/write/read; server network deadline 5 seconds; no cancellation guarantee for in-progress DB work
limitations: witness calls still hold local ledger locks
network timing, lengths, reconnections and fault patterns lack joint privacy proof
no end-to-end HPKE ciphertext through untrusted intermediaries

evidence.scope: All ledger rows synthetic; ephemeral test CA/keys; process death is not power-loss or multi-host failover validation

remaining: Complete ordered public observation protocol, terminal gap events and non-disclosing status/error strategy
Recipient receipt-only reconciliation after expiry and durable application effects protocol
Production identity enrollment, certificate/signing-key rotation and recipient inbox recovery
Independent CDDL/COSE interoperability and parser review
Load/resource limits and incremental witness architecture
Full end-to-end privacy/security proof and histogram integration

terminal_extension.scope: Separate fresh-profile extension supplies result-free post-expiry ACCEPTED/CLOSED barrier; base profile remains fail-closed at expired head
